title: Step 62-H integrated Compare/Wishlist browser acceptance
description: Accept the production Compare/Wishlist flow as one integrated Storefront experience using deterministic mock-backed SSR/API verification plus Chromium browser interaction when the isolated QA toolchain is available. Verify Listing/ProductCard selection, deterministic Compare URL, backend validation/result/removal, guest and authenticated Wishlist boundaries, cookie forwarding, idempotency transport, membership reload authority, keyboard/focus, RTL/reflow and automated axe checks. No production runtime, backend, OpenAPI, database, dependency, workflow or docs12/docs13 mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Mock-backed canonical acceptance verifies Search/Listing -> deterministic Compare URL -> backend validate -> authoritative result -> remove-to-empty flow, including reverse selection ordering and no unnecessary single-product backend Compare traffic.

Guest Wishlist remains explicitly unauthenticated with no false mutation success; authenticated Wishlist forwards only canonical customer session cookie and add/remove carry non-empty Idempotency-Key headers.
Authenticated browser flow verifies add/remove aria-pressed feedback and reload membership rehydration from GET /customer/wishlist rather than browser-local state.

Chromium acceptance verifies 320px and 1200px Step-62 flows, RTL, contained Compare horizontal scrolling, keyboard-focusable Compare region, no root horizontal overflow and zero automated WCAG violations on accepted screens.
Stage H changes only acceptance harness/package wiring/governance; production runtime app files, backend/OpenAPI/database/auth/dependencies/workflows and docs12/docs13 remain unchanged.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, deterministic review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 62-I.
